<article class="case-study">

    <h1 class="case-study__title">Redesigning a failing course</h1>
    <p class="case-study__dek">A flipped, OER-based rebuild of General Genetics that took the drop/fail/withdraw rate from 39% to under 5% — and held there for three consecutive years.</p>
    <ul class="case-skills">
      <li>Instructional systems design</li>
      <li>Data-driven iteration</li>
      <li>Equity-centered design</li>
      <li>Open educational resources</li>
      <li>Program management</li>
    </ul>
  </header>

  <section class="case-study__section">
    <h2>The problem</h2>
    <p>General Genetics at Oklahoma State had a nearly 40% drop/fail/withdraw rate. Students were failing in large numbers, the course relied on an expensive commercial textbook, and assessment was high-stakes exam-dependent — a structure the discipline-based education research literature consistently shows disadvantages underrepresented students.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="case-study__section">
    <h2>What I did</h2>
    <p>I redesigned the course from the ground up using evidence from the learning sciences. I built a complete asynchronous content library — original short-form video lectures, embedded formative assessment questions, and open educational resources — that replaced the commercial textbook entirely. Weekly active-learning sessions targeted the specific conceptual bottlenecks where students consistently got lost: ploidy, meiosis, gene regulation.</p>
    <p>Assessment moved from high-stakes exams to mastery-based: two-attempt quizzes, homework revision opportunities, and synthesis reflections. Across eight concurrent sections, structured TA mentorship kept delivery consistent.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="case-study__section">
    <h2>The outcome</h2>

    <div class="big-stat-grid">
      <div class="big-stat">
        <div class="big-stat__numbers">
          <span class="big-stat__before">39%</span>
          <span class="big-stat__arrow">→</span>
          <span class="big-stat__after">&lt;5%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="big-stat__caption">Drop/fail/withdraw rate before and after the redesign — sustained over three consecutive years.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="big-stat">
        <div class="big-stat__numbers">
          <span class="big-stat__after">200+</span>
        </div>
        <div class="big-stat__caption">Students per semester, across 8 concurrent sections, with a fully original content library.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p>The redesign was recognized with an Oklahoma Regents for Higher Education OER Grant, and students nominated the course for the Arts &amp; Sciences Distinguished Teacher Award in consecutive years.</p>

    <div class="pull-quote">This was one of the most well thought out courses I have ever taken.</div>

    <div class="pull-quote">I now have a new standard for which my future classes should be like.</div>
  </section>
